title: English Language Instruction for College: Academic Language Skills for Success

program.section_heading: English Language Instruction for College: Academic Language Skills for Success
outcomes: Demonstrate understanding, use, and application of a variety of strategies for self-editing in academic courses.
Demonstrate understanding, use, and application of many English grammatical structures important for success in academic coursework.

notes: The award is a noncredit Certificate of Competency (CDCP), but the catalog states no hours. It counts the award in units, printing '0.0 Units' for the total and 0 beside each course, so measure is 'units' and the total is recorded as the printed 0.
The catalog prints the course codes without a space (ELIC910 to ELIC913). These match closed-list ELIC 910 to ELIC 913, so none is marked as a catalog addition.

The outer heading 'English Language Instruction for College: Academic Language Skills for Success (Total 0) Complete all of the following' wraps the single block 'REQUIRED COURSES - ALL NON-CREDIT'. That inner block is the only one recorded.

The lead-in 'Upon satisfactory completion of this award, the student should be prepared to:' also appears once before an unrelated certificate heading, with no outcomes under it there. The outcomes are taken from the 'Program Learning Outcomes' heading.
The description names 'employers or prospective employers' but no career or job title, so careers is empty.
